// diagnostic

E0078

This finite value loop needs a written exhaustion route, or cannot use an immediate `?? next`/`?? break` route.

What

This finite value loop needs a written exhaustion route, or cannot use an immediate `?? next`/`?? break` route.

Why

A finite source can end without a matching `break`; `next` and `break` after the closing brace would control the loop that just closed instead of naming a target.

Fix

add `?? fallback` after the closing `}`, or write a labeled search such as `found :: loop { ... break(found, value) }`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0078: tests/ui/value_loop_exhaustion_route.stderr.

  4 |     }
    |     ^
 Why: the source can end without a matching break, so the expression must state what exhaustion means
 Fix: add `?? fallback` after the closing `}`, or use the labeled loop form for `next` or `break`
